title: How can a plant use steam generated from continuous annealing-furnace waste heat?
summary: Suneng's 2021 continuous stainless-steel annealing furnace specification uses flue gas first to preheat strip, then combustion air, and finally to generate steam in a waste-heat boiler. Steam heats drying air through an exchanger and is also distributed through a pipe network. Beyond proposed steam output, confirm destinations, timing and heat demand at each user, and how these match changing furnace load.
